## Description {#details}

The class template declaration is:

<CodeBlock>template &lt; class T, class N = T, class U = T &gt;
class micro_os_plus::utils::double_list_iterator&lt; T, N, U &gt;;</CodeBlock>

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">Type of object returned by the iterator.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="N">Type of intrusive node. Must have the public members <b>previous</b> &amp; <b>next</b>.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="U">Type stored in the list, derived from T.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>

This class provides an interface similar to <code>std::list::iterator</code>.

In a common doubly linked list, all types are <code><Link to="/docs/api/classes/micro-os-plus/utils/double-list-links">double&#95;list&#95;links</Link></code>.
